title: gouldia coriacea
intro: Gouldia coriacea, commonly known as the Western Samoan tree, is a plant species native to the Pacific Islands, particularly in Western Samoa. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional Samoan medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Gouldia coriacea include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, pain relief, and fever reduction. The bioactive constituents of Gouldia coriacea include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
